stories.title: Secure status lifted at two Richland County schools after apparent hoax call, district says

stories.title: Alex Murdaugh's attorneys ask judge to reconsider ruling on murder indictments

stories.summary: Thanksgiving travel volumes near record levels with Columbia Metropolitan Airport preparing for crowded conditions; experts advise early arrivals and extra time.

stories.summary: Midlands churches and organizations are serving Thanksgiving meals providing support for families seeking holiday food and community warmth.

stories.summary: Investigators said the woman was driving 102 mph when she struck the back of Jennifer Wingate's car on Lake Murray Boulevard in Irmo.

stories.summary: The incident involve shootings at two different locations.

stories.summary: Investigators say multiple inmates attacked the victim with a makeshift weapon.

stories.summary: The South Carolina Highway Patrol is investigating a fatal hit-and-run on Hardscrabble Road.

South Carolina ranks 39th among best states to raise a family, ConsumerAffairs report says
stories.summary: South Carolina ranked seventh for affordability but 38th for safety and public education. Connecticut topped the 2026 list.

stories.title: South Carolina flu hospitalizations nearly triple the usual pace ahead of Thanksgiving
stories.summary: State health data show 749 people hospitalized with flu since the season began Oct. 4. At this point last year, the number was 74.
